card.name: Dose limits in interaction adjustments
card.fires_on: The word or number ending a stated dose cap or reduced dose, such as 'twice daily', 'once daily' or 'up to'. It appears in interaction or dose-adjustment instructions.

modes.label: Frequency word after dose
modes.description: 'daily' or 'day' closing a reduced dose with a frequency, usually when given with an interacting drug.

modes.description: A digit or 'to' inside a maximum dose or duration limit.
modes.example: Withhold MEKTOVI for up<< to>> 4 weeks, evaluate LVEF

card.writes: Suppressed tokens are 'except' and 'unless' words, so it suggests the dose statement ends plainly without an exception clause.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a capped or reduced dose instruction, like 'twice daily' or 'up to 4 weeks'.
